text:
Mira (People Ops): Heads up team — new mandatory annual attestation window opens today. This year were rolling a small policy update (evidence:v2 tagging + dataset-encryption checkbox). Actions due in 6 business days (EOD PT): 1) Complete 8-min attestation form; 2) Link or upload required artifacts to Evidence Vault; 3) Apply the new evidence:v2 label or update team_evidence.csv. Form: https://redwood-internal.company/attest/annual-2026

Kai (Security): Summary of changes: evidence:v2 requires a source field (where asset lives), a retention note, and a dataset_encrypted=true/false flag. If dataset_encrypted=false and contains any real identifiers, you must scrub and re-upload an encrypted copy. Weve published a CLI helper: https://github.com/redwood-internal/compliance-tools/blob/main/evidence_cli.md

Nina (Legal): Managers: confirm contractors who touch customer data. Contractors need a signed attestation + DPA. Please reply with `team: contractor1, contractor2` in-thread by 48 hours so People Ops can follow up.

Dev (Eng): Quick Q: is the evidence:v2 label a git tag or file property?

Kai (Security): Good Q. It depends:
- git: append `evidence:v2` to scrub_status.md or add tag `evidence:v2` in repo metadata
- Notion/Confluence: set page property EvidenceVersion = v2 and add EvidenceLink
- S3: object tag `EvidenceVersion=v2;DatasetEncrypted=true|false`
- GDrive: add comment "evidence:v2" and drop Evidence Vault URL in doc

Mira (People Ops): Were running a light automated inventory to pre-fill Evidence Vault links for public docs and known buckets. It will not be exhaustive — please validate your teams items.

Samir (Manager): If a document is sample data (generated/synthetic), what do we mark for dataset_encrypted?

Kai (Security): If synthetic and contains no real identifiers, set DatasetEncrypted=false and add `note:synthetic-sample` in the Evidence Vault metadata. If mixed (some real values), you must scrub or encrypt per policy.

Mira (People Ops): Office hours this week to help with the new label and uploads: Mon 9-10am PT & Thu 4-5pm PT in #compliance-office-hours (Zoom): https://zoom.company/compliance. Also a short how-to doc: https://redwood-internal.company/docs/evidence-v2-howto.pdf

Dev (Eng): Any enforcement if teams ignore the label after the deadline?

Kai (Security): Well do tiered enforcement: reminders -> manager escalation -> automatic read-only lock on affected S3 prefixes/repos for non-critical items. This only applies to assets flagged as high-risk by the scanner. Well notify managers 24h before any lock.

Nina (Legal): Reminder: retention fields must match legal hold/contract obligations. If youre unsure, set retention to the minimum or add `retention: consult-legal` and tag Nina.

ComplianceBot: Reminder scheduled 514 First ping: 72 hours before deadline, follow-ups at 48h and 12h.

Samir (Manager): Confirming Infra Team: 9 people + 2 contractors (Lina, Raul) — Lina and Raul will upload attestations today.

Mira (People Ops): Thanks @Samir. For teams that complete everything before deadline well send a brief digest and mark your team as "attestation:complete" in the Compliance Dashboard. Teams that need help, please reply here and tag @Mira.

Kai (Security): Quick helper commands for S3 tagging:```bash
aws s3api put-object-tagging --bucket my-bucket --key path/to/object --tagging 'TagSet=[{Key=EvidenceVersion,Value=v2},{Key=DatasetEncrypted,Value=true}]'
```

Mira (People Ops): Final note: this rollout is to align with our SOC2 control refresh and upcoming ISO audit prep — small upfront asks to save wider rework later. Appreciate the team cooperation :heart:
